transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get started. We've got the season premiere campaign to review before I give my final approval on the publicity package. I want to make sure we go through the usual channels — music, talent publicity, network standards, and accessibility. Let's hear from each of you on where things stand.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important on the music side. I reviewed the signed music license with the publisher this morning, and there are specific terms we're not currently meeting. 'Neon Atlas' may only be used in the teaser for exactly 12 seconds — not the full 30 seconds the teaser currently runs. Additionally, the required credit is 'Neon Atlas — written by Lila Hart,' not the generic 'Original song from the series' credit that's currently in the draft campaign. I haven't yet entered these license terms into the campaign tracker, but we need to address both the usage duration and the credit language before this package goes to Mara for final approval.

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical on the talent publicity side. I confirmed with the lead actor's agent today that the actor can only do a remote interview on June 20 from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM. More importantly, the campaign cannot launch before June 20 because of the actor's publicity hold. This means the June 12 launch date currently in the campaign is not viable. I should note that the agent's confirmation is still in my email rather than the shared calendar, so I'll make sure to get that updated.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical standards issue. I checked the network's current standards bulletin this afternoon, and it confirms that every paid video containing the show's flashing-light sequence must carry the exact advisory 'Flashing lights warning' at the beginning. The draft campaign currently has no flashing-lights warning at all, so this must be added before the package can be approved. I should also note that I have not yet attached the bulletin to the campaign approval file, so I'll make sure to get that uploaded so everyone can reference it.
